32765-all-that-goes-up.title: All That Goes Up
32765-all-that-goes-up.creator: Unknown
32765-all-that-goes-up.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Well, I had learned years ago in the Prestidigitation Age, or, "You too can amaze your friends with feats of Magic" that quite often Jim would go to great lengths to mystify anybody handy. I wasn't too impressed.

arxiv-2105-14313.title: Novel Slot Detection: A Benchmark for Discovering Unknown Slot Types in the Task-Oriented Dialogue System
arxiv-2105-14313.creator: Yanan Wu, Zhiyuan Zeng, Keqing He, Hong Xu, Yuanmeng Yan, Huixing Jiang, Weiran Xu
arxiv-2105-14313.description: Abstract Existing slot filling models can only recognize pre-defined in-domain slot types from a limited slot set. In the practical application, a reliable dialogue system should know what it does not know. In this paper, we introduce a new task, Novel Slot Detection (NSD), in the task-oriented dialogue system.

arxiv-2301-12876.title: Guiding Online Reinforcement Learning with Action-Free Offline Pretraining
arxiv-2301-12876.description: Abstract Offline RL methods have been shown to reduce the need for environment interaction by training agents using offline collected episodes. However, these methods typically require action information to be logged during data collection, which can be difficult or even impossible in some practical cases.

arxiv-2304-04412.title: IR-finite thermal acceleration radiation
arxiv-2304-04412.creator: Evgenii Ievlev, Michael R.R. Good, Eric V. Linder
arxiv-2304-04412.description: Abstract A charge accelerating in a straight line following the Schwarzschild-Planck moving mirror motion emits thermal radiation for a finite period. Such a mirror motion demonstrates quantum purity and serves as a direct analogy of a black hole with unitary evolution and complete evaporation.

arxiv-2310-10652.title: BRC-20: Hope or Hype
arxiv-2310-10652.creator: Qin Wang 1 , Guangsheng Yu 1
arxiv-2310-10652.description: Abstract BRC-20 (short for Bitcoin Request for Comment 20) token mania was a key storyline in the middle of 2023. Setting it apart from conventional ERC-20 token standards on Ethereum, BRC-20 introduces non-fungibility to Bitcoin through an editable field in each satoshi (0.00000001 Bitcoin, the smallest unit), making them unique.

arxiv-2405-05541.title: CrashJS: A NodeJS Benchmark for Automated Crash Reproduction Thanks: The work of the second author was supported by a gift from Oracle Labs Australia.
arxiv-2405-05541.creator: Philip Oliver, Jens Dietrich, Craig Anslow, Michael Homer
arxiv-2405-05541.description: Abstract . Software bugs often lead to software crashes, which cost US companies upwards of $2.08 trillion annually. Automated Crash Reproduction (ACR) aims to generate unit tests that successfully reproduce a crash. The goal of ACR is to aid developers with debugging, providing them with another tool to locate where a bug is in a program.

arxiv-2407-14769.title: A Two-Phase Visualization System for Continuous Human-AI Collaboration in Sequelae Analysis and Modeling
arxiv-2407-14769.creator: Yang Ouyang, Chenyang Zhang, He Wang, Tianle Ma, Chang Jiang, Yuheng Yan, Zuoqin Yan, Xiaojuan Ma, Chuhan Shi, Quan Li
arxiv-2407-14769.description: Abstract In healthcare, AI techniques are widely used for tasks like risk assessment and anomaly detection. Despite AI’s potential as a valuable assistant, its role in complex medical data analysis often oversimplifies human-AI collaboration dynamics. To address this, we collaborated with a local hospital, engaging six physicians and one data scientist in a formative study.

arxiv-2409-01934.title: Primordial black holes: formation, spin and type II
arxiv-2409-01934.creator: Tomohiro Harada
arxiv-2409-01934.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Tomohiro Harada. Primordial black holes (PBHs) may have formed through the gravitational collapse of cosmological perturbations that were generated and stretched during the inflationary era, later entering the cosmological horizon during the decelerating phase, if their amplitudes were sufficiently large.

arxiv-2412-11283.title: Cyclic polytopes through the lens of iterated integrals
arxiv-2412-11283.creator: Felix Lotter, Rosa Preiss
arxiv-2412-11283.description: Abstract The volume of a cyclic polytope can be obtained by forming an iterated integral along a suitable piecewise linear path running through its edges. Different choices of such a path are related by the action of a subgroup of the combinatorial automorphisms of the polytope.

arxiv-2502-15803.title: Megrez-Omni Technical Report Thanks: The listing of authors is in alphabetical order based on their last names.
arxiv-2502-15803.creator: Boxun Li Yadong Li Zhiyuan Li Congyi Liu Weilin Liu Guowei Niu, Zheyue Tan Haiyang Xu Zhuyu Yao Tao Yuan Dong Zhou Yueqing Zhuang, Shengen Yan Guohao Dai Yu Wang
arxiv-2502-15803.description: Abstract In this work, we present the Megrez models, comprising a language model (Megrez-3B-Instruct) and a multimodal model (Megrez-3B-Omni). These models are designed to deliver fast inference, compactness, and robust edge-side intelligence through a software-hardware co-design approach. Megrez-3B-Instruct offers several advantages, including high accuracy, high speed, ease of use, and a wide range of applications.

arxiv-2505-16113.title: Tools in the Loop: Quantifying Uncertainty of LLM Question Answering Systems That Use Tools
arxiv-2505-16113.creator: Panagiotis Lymperopoulos, Vasanth Sarathy
arxiv-2505-16113.description: Abstract Modern Large Language Models (LLMs) often require external tools, such as machine learning classifiers or knowledge retrieval systems, to provide accurate answers in domains where their pre-trained knowledge is insufficient. This integration of LLMs with external tools expands their utility but also introduces a critical challenge: determining the trustworthiness of responses generated by the combined system.

arxiv-2505-22334.title: Advancing Multimodal Reasoning via Reinforcement Learning with Cold Start
arxiv-2505-22334.creator: Lai Wei, Yuting Li, Kaipeng Zheng, Chen Wang, Yue Wang, Linghe Kong, [0.1cm] Lichao Sun, Weiran Huang, [0.3cm] School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, [0.1cm] Shanghai Innovation Institute, [0.1cm] Zhongguancun Academy
arxiv-2505-22334.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lai Wei, Yuting Li, Kaipeng Zheng, Chen Wang, Yue Wang, Linghe Kong, [0.1cm] Lichao Sun, Weiran Huang, [0.3cm] School of Computer Science, Shanghai Jiao Tong University, [0.1cm] Shanghai Innovation Institute, [0.1cm] Zhongguancun Academy. Recent advancements in large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated impressive chain-of-thought reasoning capabilities, with reinforcement learning (RL) playing a crucial role in this progress.

arxiv-2509-26125.title: On the propagation of mountain waves: linear theory
arxiv-2509-26125.creator: Adrian Constantin, Jörg Weber
arxiv-2509-26125.description: Abstract . We derive and establish a solution concept for the linear mountain wave problem in two dimensions. After linearizing the governing equations and a change of variables, the problem can be stated as a Dirichlet boundary value problem for a Helmholtz equation in terms of the vertical wind profile in the upper half-plane, with altitude-dependent potential (the Scorer parameter).

arxiv-2510-26545.title: A test of invariance of halo surface density for FIRE-2 simulations with cold dark matter and self-interacting dark matter
arxiv-2510-26545.creator: Sujit K. Dalui, Shantanu Desai
arxiv-2510-26545.description: Abstract Numerous observations have shown that the dark matter halo surface density, defined as the product of core radius and halo central density of cored dark matter haloes is nearly constant and independent of galaxy mass over a whole slew of galaxy types.

arxiv-2601-00610.title: Vision-based Goal-Reaching Control for Mobile Robots Using a Hierarchical Learning Framework
arxiv-2601-00610.creator: Mehdi Heydari Shahna, Pauli Mustalahti, Jouni Mattila
arxiv-2601-00610.description: Abstract Reinforcement learning (RL) is effective in many robotic applications, but it requires extensive exploration of the state–action space, during which behaviors can be unsafe. This significantly limits its applicability to large robots with complex actuators operating on unstable terrain.

arxiv-2601-21817.title: A Judge-Aware Ranking Framework for Evaluating Large Language Models without Ground Truth
arxiv-2601-21817.creator: Mingyuan Xu, Xinzi Tan, Jiawei Wu, Doudou Zhou
arxiv-2601-21817.description: Abstract Evaluating large language models (LLMs) on open-ended tasks without ground-truth labels is increasingly done via the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm. A critical but under-modeled issue is that judge LLMs differ substantially in reliability; treating all judges equally can yield biased leaderboards and misleading uncertainty estimates—more data can make evaluation more confidently wrong under misspecified aggregation.

europmc-pmc3580446.description: Background Characterization of the topographical and temporal diversity of the microbial collective (microbiome) hosted by healthy human skin established a reference for studying disease-causing microbiomes. Physiologic changes occur in the skin as humans mature from infancy to

harnack-christianity-saunders-1901.title: What is Christianity?
harnack-christianity-saunders-1901.creator: Adolf von Harnack (Thomas Bailey Saunders, trans.)
harnack-christianity-saunders-1901.description: Liberal Protestantism's manifesto: the essence of Christianity as the fatherhood of God. Internet Archive edition.

pmc-10521732.title: Regulatory T cells are associated with the tumor immune microenvironment and immunotherapy response in triple-negative breast cancer
pmc-10521732.creator: Pengfei Huang, Xinyue Zhou, Minying Zheng, Yongjun Yu, Gongsheng Jin, Shiwu Zhang
pmc-10521732.description: IntroductionTriple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) is the most aggressive subtype of breast cancer with a high risk of distant metastasis, an extremely poor prognosis, and a high risk of death. Regulatory T cells (Tregs) contribute to the formation of a tumor immunosuppressive microenvironment, which plays an important role in the progression and treatment resistance of TNBC.

pmc-10653765.title: Association of acute kidney injury with the risk of cognitive impairment or dementia: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-10653765.creator: Jiang Wang, Xiao Xu, Chunyan Wang, Dongmei Ye, Ruzhao Chen, Pai Peng, Huadong Huang, Yuxiang Yan, Ying Chen, Shixuan Wang, Lan Chen, Huping Gong
pmc-10653765.description: PurposeSince previous studies have shown a paradoxical relationship between acute kidney injury (AKI) and risk of cognitive impairment, there is an urgent need for a meta-analysis to assess the relationship between AKI and risk of cognitive impairment or dementia.Materials and methodsFrom database inception to October 2023, we searched PubMed, OVID (Medline), Embase, Web of Science, and Cochrane Library.

pmc-11455917.title: Landscape ecological risk assessment and driving factor analysis in southwest china
pmc-11455917.creator: Hui Chen, Hongxing Chen, Xiaoyun Huang, Song Zhang, Tengbing He, Zhenran Gao
pmc-11455917.description: Landscape ecological risk assessment and ecological network construction are of great significance for optimizing territorial functions and reducing regional ecological risks. Based on the production-living-ecological space perspective, this study evaluated the spatiotemporal differentiation characteristics of landscape ecological risk and its driving mechanism in Southwest China and constructed a landscape ecological network.

pmc-11463332.title: Laminin-α2 chain deficiency in skeletal muscle causes dysregulation of multiple cellular mechanisms
pmc-11463332.creator: Susana G Martins, Vanessa Ribeiro, Catarina Melo, Cláudia Paulino-Cavaco, Dario Antonini, Sharadha Dayalan Naidu, Fernanda Murtinheira, Inês Fonseca, Bérénice Saget, Mafalda Pita, Diogo R Fernandes, Pedro Gameiro dos Santos, Gabriela Rodrigues, Rita Zilhão, Federico Herrera, Albena T Dinkova-Kostova
pmc-11463332.description: This work reveals the defects caused by the absence of laminin-α2, including impaired myoblast proliferation and differentiation, DNA damage, oxidative stress, and mitochondrial dysfunction, highlighting its important role in muscle development and cellular homeostasis. Introduction Muscle formation and growth are processes that start early in embryonic development and continue postnatally.

pmc-11514012.title: Including Photoexcitation Explicitly in Trajectory-Based Nonadiabatic Dynamics at No Cost
pmc-11514012.creator: Jiří Janoš, Petr Slavíček, Basile F E Curchod
pmc-11514012.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Over the last decades, theoretical photochemistry has produced multiple techniques to simulate the nonadiabatic dynamics of molecules. Surprisingly, much less effort has been devoted to adequately describing the first step of a photochemical or photophysical process: photoexcitation. Here, we propose a formalism to include the effect of a laser pulse in trajectory-based nonadiabatic dynamics at the level of the initial conditions, with no additional cost.

pmc-12580861.title: Efficacy and Safety of T‐DXd in HER2+ and Low/Zero Metastatic BCBM: A Retrospective Multicenter Real‐World Study
pmc-12580861.creator: Qingru Zhou, Yuanyuan Li, Ni He, Guorong Zou, Mengqian Ni, Lulu Zhang, Shu Dun, Zhanhong Chen, Kejun Liu, Yabing Cao, Jiajia Huang, Fei Xu, Zhongyu Yuan, Shusen Wang, Yanxia Shi, Yonggao Mou, Anli Yang, Lixia Li, Xin An
pmc-12580861.description: Accumulating data demonstrate the robust overall and intracranial activity of trastuzumab deruxtecan (T‐DXd) in HER2‐positive breast cancer brain metastasis (BCBM). Limited data are available on HER2‐low/zero BCBM, as well as patients with symptomatic active BM, leptomeningeal disease (LMD), and poor performance status. This multicenter, retrospective, real‐world study enrolled patients diagnosed with HER2‐positive or low/zero BCBM receiving T‐DXd.

pmc-12615620.title: Combining K-fold cross validation with bayesian hyperparameter optimization for accuracy enhancement of land cover and land use classification
pmc-12615620.creator: Pooya Heidari, Asghar Milan
pmc-12615620.description: Land cover and land use (LCLU) information is crucial in different earth observation applications, such as environmental management, infrastructure planning, and urban development. Recently, deep learning has emerged as an effective technique for image processing and spatial analysis, with excellent accuracies in image classification. However, training deep learning models for LCLU classification using remote sensing data continues to be challenging.

pmc-13060726.title: Effects of Monocular Perceptual Learning on Eye-Specific Cortical Activity in Residual Anisometropic Amblyopia: Evidence From EEG Asymmetry
pmc-13060726.creator: Zixuan Xu, Yusong Zhou, Yangfei Pang, Yunsi He, Wentong Yu, Yudan Zhong, Qiuying Li, Qingqing Ye, Junpeng Yuan, Xuan Qiu, Yun Wen, Jinrong Li
pmc-13060726.description: PurposeThe purpose of this study was to investigate whether a 30-day monocular perceptual learning (PL) program improves visual function and cortical activity in children with residual anisometropic amblyopia.MethodsIn this prospective interventional study, 38 patients (8–15 years old) with monocular residual anisometropic amblyopia completed a 30-day home-based monocular PL program using the lateral masking paradigm.

pmc-13336016.title: Time‐Multiplexed Organic Electrochemical Transistor for Saliva‐Based Rapid Detection of Viral Proteins
pmc-13336016.creator: Tianrui Chang, Yuxiang Ren, Shofarul Wustoni, Atheer Alqatari, Adel Hama, Yazhou Wang, Long Chen, Jessica Parrado Agudelo, Luca Salvigni, Keying Guo, Ashraf Dada, Stefan T Arold, Raik Grünberg, Sahika Inal
pmc-13336016.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Timely and accurate diagnosis of respiratory infections is complicated by the symptomatic overlap between highly transmissible pathogens such as respiratory syncytial virus (RSV), influenza A (IAV), and influenza B (IBV), highlighting the need for rapid and reliable diagnostics. Here, we report a time‐multiplexed nanobody‐functionalized organic electrochemical transistor (OECT) biosensor for the sensitive detection of RSV, IAV, and IBV directly from unprocessed saliva samples.

pmc-13407251.title: Enfortumab Vedotin in Advanced or Metastatic Urothelial Carcinoma: A Systematic Review of Efficacy, Safety, and Clinical Perspectives
pmc-13407251.creator: Julia Piekarz, Natalia Picheta, Jakub Pobideł, Karolina Daniłowska, Natalia Gierulska, Katarzyna Szklener, Magdalena Skórzewska
pmc-13407251.description: Simple SummaryAdvanced bladder cancer, or urothelial carcinoma, is an aggressive disease with historically low survival rates and limited treatment options once standard therapies fail. Enfortumab vedotin is a promising targeted therapy called an antibody–drug conjugate that delivers chemotherapy directly to cancer cells while boosting the body’s immune response.
